briefdescription.para: Infer the sign of an internally represented division expression.

detaileddescription.para: Applies the sign multiplication table for division: positive ÷ positive → positive, negative ÷ negative → positive, positive ÷ negative → negative, negative ÷ positive → negative. Returns Unknown when denominator sign is unknown or zero.

briefdescription.para: Infer the sign of an internally represented division expression.

briefdescription.para: Infer the sign of an internally represented subtraction expression.

detaileddescription.para: Detects a negated subtrahend and applies subtraction sign rules, such as positive minus negative producing a positive result.

briefdescription.para: Infer the monotonicity of an expression with respect to a variable on an interval.

detaileddescription.para:
Auto-infers monotonicity for known functions:
exp: Increasing on all of ℝ
ln: Increasing on ℝ⁺ (positive reals)
negation (multiply by -1): reverses monotonicity
Also checks PropertyStore for user-declared monotonicity.

parameterdescription.para: The variable with respect to which monotonicity is queried
The interval on which to check monotonicity

simplesect.para: The inferred Monotonicity classification

briefdescription.para: Infer sign of an arithmetic expression by checking relational constraints.

detaileddescription.para:
Examines the RelationStore for GT/GEQ zero patterns on operands of sums and products:
sum: all operands GT 0 -> Positive; all GEQ 0 -> NonNegative
product: all operands GT 0 -> Positive
Also checks: x GT y with y non-negative → x is Positive

simplesect.para: True if the target sign can be inferred from relations, Unknown otherwise

briefdescription.para: Derives properties of composite expressions by recursively analyzing sub-expressions.

detaileddescription.para: The InferenceEngine implements arithmetic inference rules for addition, multiplication, power, and function expressions. It determines sign, domain, and boundedness properties based on the properties of operands/arguments.

Sign inference rules:
Addition: uniform sign → same sign on sum; mixed/unknown → Unknown
Multiplication: zero → Zero; parity of negatives determines sign; unknown → Unknown
Power: positive base + real exponent → Positive; even exponent → NonNegative; etc.
Functions: exp → Positive; abs → NonNegative; sin/cos → Bounded[-1,1]; etc.

Domain inference rules:
Addition: all Integer → Integer; all Real → Real
Multiplication: all Integer → Integer; all Real/Integer → Real
Power: Real base + integer exponent → Real
Functions: exp/sin/cos/abs/sqrt/ln/tan with Real argument → Real
